name: Kuwait
description: Kuwait from its traders and pearl divers to British protection, oil, independence, the Iraqi invasion and liberation.

checkpoints.name: Port of traders
checkpoints.note: Failaka was a Bronze Age trading post. The Al-Sabah family ruled the port of Kuwait from the 1750s, a town of ships and pearl divers.

checkpoints.name: Protectorate and oil
checkpoints.note: An agreement with Britain in 1899 made Kuwait a protectorate, and oil was found at Burgan in 1938.

checkpoints.name: Independent Kuwait
checkpoints.note: Kuwait became independent in 1961. Iraq invaded in 1990, and Kuwait was freed in 1991 as its oil wells burned.
